context.transcript:
Welcome to Nutrition Talk on WKMN Radio!
Our guest today, Alexis Morris, is a nutritionist who recently released a mobile phone app.
The new app helps you track what you eat and gives you nutritional information about that food.
Today we'll be talking with Ms. Morris about the importance of meal tracking.
I've kept records of my meal choices for years now, and l've tried a lot of other applications like this.
I can honestly say that this is the best one I've ever used.
We'll talk with Ms. Morris right after this commercial break.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎收听 WKMN 电台的营养讲座！
我们今天的嘉宾是 Alexis Morris，她是一位营养师，最近发布了一款手机应用程序。
这款新应用可以帮助您追踪您的饮食，并提供关于这些食物的营养信息。
今天我们将和 Morris 女士讨论餐食记录的重要性。
我已经记录我的膳食选择很多年了，我也尝试过许多类似的应用程序。
我敢说这是我用过的最好的一个。
在广告休息之后，我们将与 Morris 女士交谈。
